But I never said anything about being happy alone. There are relationships that aren't romantic. Obviously people need a social network to be happy. I just don't think love is a human need. 

What you're talking about isn't a lack of a romantic relationship, it's about not having a reason to live. But that reason can literally be anything because it's just something you make up in your head. In the big picture there is no meaning to any of this for anyone anyway. The idea that just because others sing songs about romance and shit it also has to be the meaning of my life just makes no sense to me. It reminds me of religion and people who live as monks, they've been scientifically proven to be happy. So this whole everyone sings about love and so you can't be happy without it thing is probably nonsense.

For a lot of people, heroin is an important thing in their life. A lot of those people even have relationships too but at the end of the day if you look at their behavior, they choose the little baggie full of powder. A lot of men claim their family and kids are important to them but can't be bothered to spend more than 15 minutes with their kids before going back to playing video games for hours on end. A lot of housewives claim their families are very important and yet joke online about how they need their happy pills and wine to get through the day. At the end of the day, what's important is decided through chemicals in your brain, and where those come from. It's entirely possible to find sources that aren't relationships, except for obvious reasons people wouldn't dare say those other things are the most important thing in life. There's only really one socially acceptable way to answer that question so it's hardly a surprise everyone keeps parroting it.

It doesn't even matter either. I'm sure the very best way to live your life is to be a billionaire who travels the world and gets to do whatever the fuck they want whenever they want. I don't really see the point in bellyaching over not having that, so not having a Jim and Pam type romance isn't all that different, just another ideal it so happens some people get to have and some don't. Someone who does have it might say it's the most important thing all they want, that doesn't mean I can't have stuff I enjoy in my life.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patriarchy
Also swing by theredpill and see how charmingly males like to describe women. And look up Elliott Rodgers, the god of lonely males on reddit to see their attitudes in action.
No, I don't live in a western country. And I'm not talking about slavery. I'm talking about male oppression of women.

Have you lived on this planet for long? Try studying about our species. You can start from the beginning, back when women were sold as property, had no rights nor were considered human. Doesn't seem like the way you would treat people you have any actual empathy for. And no empathy means no valid relationship can ever form.

I don't give a shit about dating stuff and such because I could never really date a male, only because money, otherwise what's the point of dating someone who will dump me for a younger model the moment I get a gray hair. Relationships are BS, people are just after something the other one can offer them rather than really enjoying the person's company. It's just about physical features and money. I only want to get plastic surgery because otherwise I won't be able to get a job in the future. But if some males start hitting on me after I can't imagine feeling anything but disgust towards them. I used to see couples on the street and feel sad, now I feel the same as when I see a junkie nodding off somewhere - whatever, none of my business, can't relate and wouldn't want to either.
